hooks.command: $root = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $refresh = Join-Path $root 'scripts\graphify-refresh.ps1'; $expected = '2146a932e00c8493f379a69de489df98d73de70c83d43ca7642d8f3703c50fce'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $refresh) { $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($refresh).Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n"); $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create(); try { $bytes = (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)).GetBytes($text); $actual = ($sha.ComputeHash($bytes) | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') }) -join '' } finally { $sha.Dispose() }; if ($actual -eq $expected) { & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $refresh -Mode Ensure } else { Write-Warning 'Graphify refresh script hash mismatch; hook skipped.' } } else { Write-Warning 'Graphify refresh script missing; hook skipped.' } }
